title: GLOBESUMM: A Challenging Benchmark Towards Unifying Multi-lingual, Cross-lingual and Multi-document News Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating an entailment score using a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model to measure the proportion of content in the generated summaries that originates from different source languages, revealing models' preferences for high-resource languages over low-resource languages.

Evaluating a Conflict Resolution Effectiveness (CRE) metric to assess how well models handle contradictory information and misunderstandings arising from diverse national standpoints, differing viewpoints, and cultural discrepancies across multilingual news reports.
